messages:
maria: Post-all-hands follow-up: logging the security/compliance questions people raised. Short thread so we can assign owners.

leah: I'll coordinate SOC2/ISO evidence and the attestation packet.

omar: Customer asked if we publish an attestation letter and whether Hosted is in-scope.

leah: Yes, we publish an attestation. Hosted services are in-scope for Redwood-managed controls; customers must supply their own control evidence where applicable. We'll add clarity to the trust center.

ashok: VPC/VPN question: infra will produce per-region network diagrams and a deployment manifest showing PrivateLink and peering. ETA: 2026-07-28.

samir: KMS notes: we support HSM-backed BYOK, and Redwood-managed wrapping keys rotate every 90 days. Emergency unwrap requires two approvers and is fully audited. I'll draft the internal runbook.

maria: Audit logs: what's default retention and can customers export immutable snapshots?

ashok: Default hosted retention = 90 days. Dedicated can be configured up to 3 years. We can provide signed, time-stamped log bundles for exports on request.

product_ops: I'll publish a one-page FAQ for sales covering retention tiers, residency, BYOK, and emergency unwrap. Please send bullets by 2026-07-07.

leah: Action items: 1) Attestation + evidence index (leah) due 2026-07-12. 2) Network diagrams + manifest (ashok) due 2026-07-28. 3) Emergency unwrap runbook (samir) due 2026-07-06. 4) Customer FAQ one-pager (product_ops) due 2026-07-07.

ops-bot: Reminders set for leah (2026-07-12), ashok (2026-07-28), samir (2026-07-06).

maria: Thanks all 1 closing thread; ping here for blockers.
